headline: Evening Action Focuses on Farranac Coast and Fishermans Row
war_summary: Since the last edition, strategic-base events have narrowed to two fronts: Farranac Coast and Fishermans Row each logged events in the final two hours, three and four respectively. Scythe and Terra lead Farranac's daily list with five events apiece, while Fort Ember and Hangman's Court are the busiest points in Fishermans Row. Tempest Island, active through the afternoon, has been quiet for two hours but still shows fifteen daily events, with Blackwatch foremost. Stlican Shelf recorded its latest strategic-base event at 18:52, and Godcrofts has not logged one since 17:27 despite Lipsia's eight daily events. Lykos Isle, with twenty-five daily events, has cooled to three in the last six hours. DeadLands has stood still since 13:25. Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow remain heavy casualty fronts without strategic-base flips in the latest window. The 101st day of the war finds no side holding thirty-four victory towns.
